verdict.rationale: Scraped data comes back in standard, portable formats: markdown, HTML, and structured JSON (firecrawl-docs-1, firecrawl-gh-9). Firecrawl is also open source under AGPL-3.0 and available as a hosted service, which reduces lock-in through self-hosting or forking (firecrawl-gh-6, firecrawl-gh-10, firecrawl-comm-2). However, the evidence shows no dedicated export or migration feature, and the cloud version includes extra features not in the open-source build. Missing for 10: an export of job/crawl configurations, a bulk data export or migration tool, and documentation of portability between the cloud and self-hosted versions.
